title: What a Business Actually Is
content:
A business is a system that identifies a need, creates or coordinates value, delivers that value, and captures enough economic value to continue operating. Revenue is not the definition of a business; value exchange is. Study the relationship among customer problem, offer, delivery mechanism, cost structure, and cash collection.

2. Identify three assumptions in your analysis and state what evidence would confirm or falsify each.
